title: {{APP}}: Learn Chinese
short: Learn Chinese words offline, one a day, with pinyin and spaced repetition.
full:
{{APP}} helps you learn beginner Mandarin Chinese, one word a day, entirely offline.

Every day you get one word at level {{LEVEL_RANGE}}: the characters, the pinyin, the meaning, an example sentence and a short note. The word bank holds {{WORDS}} words in simplified characters.

• Save words to your vault and review them with spaced repetition: words you know come back later, words you miss come back sooner.
• Review in several formats: fill-in-the-blank typed in characters or in pinyin, rebuilding a sentence from tiles, picking the right tone, finding the mistake, multiple choice, matching pairs and flashcards.
• Pinyin when you need it: it fades as a word grows familiar. You can also keep it always on, or show it only when you tap.
• Drill grammar: pick the right measure word, and choose between 是, 在 and 有; 吗 and 呢; 二 and 两; and 不 and 没.
• Start with a short pronunciation guide to tones and pinyin.
• Listen to words and sentences read aloud by your phone's text-to-speech (a Chinese voice must be installed).
• Optional daily reminders, a learning streak and statistics.
• Back up your data to a file and restore it on another phone.

Free, with no ads and no account. Your learning data stays on your device, and everything except the optional AI notes works offline.

Optional AI notes: if you add your own API key from a supported provider, {{APP}} can ask it for extra examples and a usage note for a word. This is off by default; only the word, its meaning, its level and your app language are sent, straight to the provider you chose.

The app's interface is available in English and Italian. It runs on Android.
